definition.def: Intervention is the act of intervening in a situation.
examples: ...the role of the United States and its intervention in the internal affairs of many countries. [+ in]

definition.def: An intervention is an occasion when friends or family tell someone who has a serious problem that they need to get help.
examples: Finally, his wife staged an intervention and he agreed to go into rehab.
Her friends decided it was time for an intervention.
